payingUser: A hobby 3D-print maker who has an existing STL or 3MF file and wants to repair and verify it on a phone before sending it to a slicer.
paidUnit: One permanent unlock of on-device mesh repair, print-risk analysis, bed-fit transforms, hollowing, plate arrangement, and prepared-file export.
momentOfPayment: After the user imports a model and sees its free geometry report, before applying a repair or exporting the prepared model.
distinctnessSentence: The app changes and checks an existing mesh locally, then exports the repaired, bed-fitted file instead of stopping at model viewing or printer control.
day1RevenuePath: A maker finds the app from STL-repair or phone-slicing search, imports a mesh, sees the free risk preview, and buys the permanent unlock through Play Billing before repairing and exporting; the scanner measured adjacent free listings with IAP badges but not their IAP prices.
assumptionsUnverified: UNVERIFIED: no screened competitor exposed a paid-up-front price or an IAP product price, so $9.99 is an experiment rather than a measured comparable.
UNVERIFIED: 65 monthly unlocks are needed to reach $500 modeled monthly net proceeds, but no relevant Play conversion rate was measured.
INFERRED: the modeled $7.81 net per sale assumes a 15% Play fee and an 8% tax haircut on a $9.99 sticker price; actual Play fee enrollment, tax incidence, refunds, and currency are unknown.
UNVERIFIED: large real-world models may exceed phone memory or latency budgets, and the parser and repair pipeline need representative device measurements.

capabilities.note: INFERRED: one permanent premium unlock uses Play Billing; ads are excluded because the local file-preparation task is occasional and focused.

permissions: INFERRED: no runtime permissions, account, or network access; SAF file selection and FileProvider share/export are user-initiated, and Play Billing supplies the purchase capability.

archetypesRejected.revenueReason: INFERRED: mesh repair is a durable local capability with no variable server cost, and recon found no defensible repeat consumable to sell without inventing artificial content packs.
INFERRED: model preparation is an occasional focused session rather than a frequent ad-impression habit, so ad inventory is unlikely to pay for this large local geometry build.

MEASURED: all eight enriched apps in the slice-to-phone set list for free, so charging before a maker can inspect their own model abandons the observed free-install funnel without paid-download precedent.
